title: Forward daemon feature handlers to commercial, then delete from core after a Linux pass
goal: Vision: V-9. Mandate 84 / board 2617. After commercial T-GROKCORESIZE-2 has a working destination, forward core's daemon plane callers for the first-increment topics (privacy, ambient start, services control, os provision, context sample-os) to the plug host over the existing plane-bus contracts, naming the commercial command when the host is absent. When Windows and Linux passes both succeed, delete the core implementations in the same change that lowers COMPLETE_SOCKET_CEILING. Core keeps daemon contracts, transport and the plane bus. No stubs and no lost function.

reuse.searched: Core forwarding in crates/susi-config/src/vault_exec.rs and src/cli/tasks_cli.rs (eval-corpus); plane dispatch in crates/susi-daemon/src/plane_handler.rs.

limitations: Linux evidence above is for the deletion-only tree at f9c857b43. After board 2795/2799 typed facades were restored; after board 2817/2829/2833 the original public ambient implementation and CLI were restored from 4de036347; after board 2834 os_provision::probe_all and the infallible OS sampler were kept in core because plug-only facades lost function when the host was absent (false AlreadyRunning, pulse changed=0, all five CLIs unavailable). Board 2835's persist_privacy_mode correction is included. Measured count is therefore 288,877, not 287,873 or 288,256. Windows re-verified the restored tree, including the GNU ambient behavior test, absent-host sampling, and inventory that does not blame a missing plug host. The 712-line MCP repair (board 2786) no longer fits under 289,216 after these restores; board 2834 notes the GMCP owner accepted it under T-CORESIZEVAULT-18. The pre-existing gossip AddrInUse flake is not part of this change. CachyOS was offline; Linux was run on SusiCoreSizeVault / cloud Ubuntu 24.04. Stays out of harness, T-CORESIZEFIX-1, Codex areas, and the GEMI pillar.
progress: Windows-green with public ambient, OS sampling, and local cloud-CLI inventory kept in core (board 2817, 2829, 2833, 2834). COMPLETE_SOCKET_CEILING 289,216 -> 288,877 (339-line net cut). set_privacy_mode still forwards over the plane bus; persist_privacy_mode keeps the original local sticky write so it does not rewrite a caller-owned routing preference (board 2835). service_control still forwards; ambient start/pulse, context_adapters sampling, and os_provision::probe_all run locally so a missing plug host cannot report a false running indexer, a zero pulse, a zero sample, or all five cloud CLIs unavailable. Linux pass (CORESIZEVAULT / cloud Ubuntu 24.04, rustc 1.99.0, board 2794) was on refs/agents/grok-coresize-1 f9c857b43 merged with fa4131e80 (deletion-only tree, 287,873): susi-daemon-runtime lib 143/143, architecture_tests 61/61, lean_core_ceilings 3 passed/1 ignored, fmt clean, clippy -D warnings clean, cargo core-size 287,873 (goal unmet). susi-daemon lib 195 passed, 1 failed: gossip::tests::host_only_scopes_the_socket_to_loopback_and_back AddrInUse at gossip.rs:656.
